paper.title_en: Stronger-to-weaker gravity in generalized Brans-Dicke cosmology and implications for the Hubble and $S_8$ tensions
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the cosmological implications of a Brans--Dicke-type scalar-tensor theory with non-minimal coupling $A(ϕ)=1+c_1ϕ+c_2ϕ^2$ and power-law potentials $V(ϕ)\proptoϕ^{2n}$ ($n=2,3,4$), in which the dynamics of the scalar field yields a time-varying effective gravitational strength $G_{\rm eff}$. The theory is restricted to ghost-free solutions that also satisfy the dominant energy condition, sub-Planckian field ranges, as well as solar-system and big-bang nucleosynthesis bounds, keeping the scalar sector in a well-controlled and motivated regime. When confronting the model with Planck CMB, DESI DR2 BAO and Pantheon+ supernova data with the SH0ES calibration, the preferred scalar field dynamics lowers the sound horizon and raises the Hubble constant to $H_0=71.09\pm0.66\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ for $n=3$, which also shows a moderate Bayesian preference over $Λ$CDM ($\ln B=4.55\pm0.44$) under the adopted priors. We show that, within this framework, the early stronger-gravity and late weaker-gravity phases compete for the same coefficients, forcing the latter to have amplitudes bounded by $1-G_{\rm eff}/G \lesssim 10^{-4}$. The data also prefer only brief weaker-gravity excursions after recombination for $n=2$ and $n=3$, lasting less than $0.1$ e-folds, but $n=4$ shows late-time transitions at $z\lesssim 3$ persisting for up to $\sim 1.9$ e-folds. In all cases the weaker-gravity regime is far too shallow to suppress the growth of structure: the $S_8$ parameter is in fact higher than in $Λ$CDM and the preferred cosmologies are of the early-modified-gravity type.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究了带有非最小耦合与幂律势的Brans-Dicke型标量-张量理论，并系统施加鬼自由、主能量条件、亚普朗克场范围、太阳系与BBN约束，属于典型的修改引力工作；结合CMB、BAO与超新星数据对H0与S8张力的分析具有明确的可读性与理论深度，值得点击细读。
decision.title_zh: 广义Brans-Dicke宇宙学中从较强到较弱的引力及其对Hubble与$S_8$张力的意义
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种Brans--Dicke型标量-张量理论的宇宙学含义，该理论具有非最小耦合$A(\phi)=1+c_1\phi+c_2\phi^2$与幂律势$V(\phi)\propto\phi^{2n}$（$n=2,3,4$），其中标量场的动力学产生随时间变化的有效引力强度$G_{\rm eff}$。该理论被限制在无鬼解上，这些解同时满足主能量条件、亚普朗克场范围，以及太阳系与big-bang核合成约束，从而使标量扇区保持在一个受良好控制且有动机的区域。当用Planck CMB、DESI DR2 BAO与Pantheon+超新星数据并结合SH0ES校准来检验该模型时，所偏好的标量场动力学降低了声视界并把Hubble常数提高到$H_0=71.09\pm0.66\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$（$n=3$），在所用先验下这也相对$\Lambda$CDM显示出中等的贝叶斯偏好（$\ln B=4.55\pm0.44$）。我们表明，在该框架内，早期较强引力与晚期较弱引力两个阶段争夺同一组系数，迫使后者的振幅被限制在$1-G_{\rm eff}/G \lesssim 10^{-4}$。数据对于$n=2$与$n=3$也仅偏好复合之后短暂的较弱引力偏离，持续时间少于$0.1$个e-folds，但$n=4$显示出在$z\lesssim 3$处晚时转变可持续至$\sim 1.9$个e-folds。在所有情形中，较弱引力区域都过于浅，远不足以抑制结构增长：$S_8$参数实际上高于$\Lambda$CDM中的值，并且所偏好的宇宙学属于早期修改引力类型。
